title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
summary: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.
title_es: OpenAI lanza ChatGPT Wallet para agentes IA
bajada: OpenAI presentó ChatGPT Wallet, una billetera digital segura que permite a los agentes realizar compras en nombre de usuarios con su aprobación. La herramienta se integra con Visa, Mastercard y American Express, marcando un paso importante hacia la autonomía de los agentes IA en transacciones comerciales.
bajada_en: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, a secure digital wallet enabling agents to complete purchases on behalf of users with their approval. The tool integrates with Visa, Mastercard, and American Express, marking a significant step toward AI agent autonomy in commercial transactions.

title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
summary: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.
title_es: LangChain alcanza valoración de $3B con 7,000 clientes
bajada: LangChain, plataforma agnóstica para gestión de agentes IA, llegó a una valoración de $3 mil millones y reporta 7,000 clientes usando LangSmith. Este hito refleja la creciente demanda de herramientas para orquestar agentes en producción.
bajada_en: LangChain, an agnostic platform for AI agent management, reached a $3 billion valuation with 7,000 customers using LangSmith. This milestone reflects growing demand for tools to orchestrate agents in production environments.

title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
summary: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.
title_es: Partida de Jensen Huang impacta financiamiento de startups IA
bajada: Fundadores y VCs advierten que la salida de Jensen Huang de NVIDIA reduce significativamente el financiamiento disponible para startups IA, ya que Huang canalizaba miles de millones en capital. Cambio importante en la dinámica de inversión del sector.
bajada_en: Founders and VCs warn that Jensen Huang's departure from NVIDIA significantly reduces available funding for AI startups, as Huang channeled tens of billions in capital. Important shift in sector investment dynamics.

title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem

bajada: Hugging Face anuncia el lanzamiento de llama.cpp v1.0.0, consolidando la herramienta como infraestructura clave para ejecutar modelos localmente. Esta versión estable refuerza el ecosistema de IA descentralizada y accesible para developers.
bajada_en: Hugging Face announces llama.cpp v1.0.0, solidifying the tool as key infrastructure for running models locally. This stable release strengthens the decentralized and accessible AI ecosystem for developers.

bajada: OpenAI expande ChatGPT Wallet con soporte de las principales tarjetas de crédito, permitiendo que agentes completen transacciones sin acceso directo a datos sensibles. El rollout inicial alcanza usuarios Pro en Estados Unidos.

title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
summary: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.
title_es: ChatGPT Wallet permite que agentes hagan compras automáticas
bajada: ChatGPT Wallet expande capacidades de agentes para realizar compras y checkouts en nombre de usuarios. El rollout limitado a suscriptores Pro estadounidenses marca el inicio de transacciones autónomas en la plataforma.
bajada_en: ChatGPT Wallet expands agent capabilities to complete purchases and checkouts on behalf of users. Limited rollout to US Pro subscribers marks the beginning of autonomous transactions on the platform.

bajada_en: OpenAI launched Codex Security, a tool to automatically find, investigate, and fix code vulnerabilities. Available in Codex and as CLI/SDK for CI/CD pipeline integration.

title: Shield helps technicians hand off legacy portal work with OpenAI
summary: Shield uses OpenAI to help IT technicians hand off work in legacy portals. Its Forge agents navigate systems so technicians can focus on issues needing their judgment.
title_es: Shield automatiza transición de sistemas legacy con IA
bajada: Shield implementa agentes de OpenAI para que técnicos migren trabajo de portales heredados, liberándolos para tareas que requieren juicio humano. Un caso de uso práctico de agentes IA en operaciones IT.
bajada_en: Shield deploys OpenAI agents to help technicians migrate work from legacy portals, freeing them for judgment-intensive tasks. A practical use case for AI agents in IT operations.

Claude Duet is Anthropic's AI agent for consumers, the latest attempt by an AI company to try to convince us that agents can be useful for people who don't write code. It's been an interesting couple […]

bajada: Anthropic lanzó Claude Duet, un agente IA diseñado para consumidores que busca demostrar la utilidad práctica de los agentes más allá de coding. The Verge documenta una experiencia interesante aunque anecdótica con la herramienta.
bajada_en: Anthropic launched Claude Duet, an AI agent for consumers designed to demonstrate practical utility beyond coding. The Verge documents an interesting though anecdotal experience with the tool.

title: AI unlocks Gödel's notebooks, said to contain hundreds of proved theorems
title_es: IA desbloquea notebooks de Gödel con cientos de teoremas
bajada: Investigadores utilizaron IA para descifrar las notas manuscritas de Kurt Gödel, revelando cientos de teoremas matemáticos previamente ocultos. Un caso fascinante de IA aplicada a la historia científica y las matemáticas.
bajada_en: Researchers used AI to decipher Kurt Gödel's handwritten notes, revealing hundreds of previously hidden mathematical theorems. A fascinating case of AI applied to scientific history and mathematics.

title: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
title_es: XYBench: benchmark para agentes de datos IA
bajada: Allen AI lanza XYBench, un benchmark que evalúa la capacidad de agentes IA para entender el contexto detrás de preguntas en tareas de datos. Recurso útil para evaluación de agentes data-driven.
bajada_en: Allen AI launches XYBench, a benchmark evaluating AI agents' ability to understand context behind questions in data tasks. Useful resource for assessing data-driven agents.

title: Together Compiler: Continual Compilation for AI Inference
summary:
arXiv:2611.14681v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Today's AI workloads are rapidly changing: new models are released more often, model architectures are increasingly diverse, and traffic distributions change frequently. The challenge we face at Together AI is continual optimization for these changing workloads. Compiling a deployment into an optimized forward pass is a challenge that is well-suited for agent hill-climbing. Existing systems struggle with continual compilation due to a tradeoff between measurement throughput and fidelity. Many systems use agents to optimize individual kernels from the inference forward pass using offline benchmarks, but timings are low-fidelity because of data-dependent behavior in primitives like mixture-of-experts (MoE). On the other hand, systems use agents to directly optimize end-to-end engines but suffer from slow engine launch times. To address these challenges, we build Together Compiler (TKCC), the first truly continual agent loop designed for AI inference optimization. To address the throughput-fidelity tradeoff, we propose: (1) a Tiered Persistent Engine that decouples engine launch overheads from forward pass computation; (2) a cost model to select the parallelism configurations that seed the optimization process. We also conduct extensive ablations on agent context management and present our insights on deploying TKCC in production. TKCC outperforms highly-optimized hand-written Megakernels on the Llama 1B workhorse workload by up to 1.7x and the best open source engines on the latest frontier models (Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash) across hardware platforms by up to 2.6x higher TPS on the InferenceX benchmark. TKCC also sets the state-of-the-art performance at batch size 1, with 1111 TPS on M3.1 Flash and 1205 TPS on DeepSeek v4.1 Flash. Finally, TKCC generalizes beyond frontier language model inference. TKCC serves trillions of tokens across our production fleet.
title_es: Together Compiler: compilación continua para inferencia IA
bajada: Together AI presenta un sistema que optimiza continuamente la compilación de modelos IA ante cambios en cargas de trabajo y arquitecturas. Paper técnico sobre optimización de inferencia en producción con agentes.
bajada_en: Together AI presents a system that continuously optimizes AI model compilation as workloads and architectures change. Technical paper on production inference optimization using agents.

title: SynthCorp: A Platform for Creating Benchmarks for Data Agents
summary:
arXiv:2611.14765v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Current benchmarks for LLM-driven data agents saturate quickly and cannot target specific capabilities. We present SynthCorp, a platform that creates customizable data estates and benchmarks by simulating how business events produce and modify corporate data over time. Each data estate combines relational databases, a document store, and a data catalog, paired with evaluation tasks and executable gold programs. First, given a scenario and target complexity dimensions, SynthCorp synthesizes reusable event types and compiles each into a program over predefined simulation primitives. Second, SynthCorp schedules event instances on a virtual calendar, interleaving routine and disruption events so that tables, documents, and catalog entries remain consistent. Third, SynthCorp executes the calendar to materialize the data estate and records every operation in a simulation log. Fourth, SynthCorp generates analytical tasks and derives verified gold programs from the log. We use SynthCorp to generate initial evaluation benchmarks comprising seven data estates (up to 1K operational tables) and 256 tasks across five domains. The data estates pass deterministic pipeline checks (such as foreign-key violations, undeclared writes, recurrence violations, and database execution failures) with a near-zero error rate, introduce cross-asset complexities, and cover all requested dimensions. Evaluating three models across four data-context settings shows that the benchmarks separate data contexts and model tiers. Auditing candidate queries against causal provenance in the simulation log verifies gold programs without manual annotation, including on multi-event composite tasks that expose reasoning failures in state-of-the-art agents. We hope the community uses SynthCorp to generate more challenging and useful data estates and benchmarks that foster the development of enterprise data agents.
title_es: SynthCorp: plataforma para benchmarks de agentes de datos
bajada: Investigadores presentan SynthCorp, plataforma que genera benchmarks personalizados simulando cómo eventos empresariales crean datos corporativos. Herramienta útil para evaluar agentes LLM en tareas de datos realistas.
bajada_en: Researchers present SynthCorp, a platform that generates customizable benchmarks by simulating how business events create corporate data. Useful tool for evaluating LLM agents on realistic data tasks.

title: Tesla Announces Cybercab for Personal Use
summary: Tesla is offering to “select customers” the opportunity to purchase Cybercab, its fully autonomous two-seat electric vehicle that lacks a steering wheel and pedals.In a post on X, the company lists an estimated purchase price of $29,990, which will make it the cheapest Tesla vehicle available. ...
title_es: Tesla ofrece Cybercab a $29,990 para usuarios seleccionados
bajada: Tesla anuncia disponibilidad del Cybercab totalmente autónomo a clientes seleccionados, posicionándolo como el vehículo Tesla más accesible. Aunque relevante para autonomía, tiene impacto limitado en el sector tech de IA.
bajada_en: Tesla announces Cybercab availability to select customers at $29,990, positioning it as the most affordable Tesla vehicle. While relevant to autonomy, it has limited impact on the AI tech sector.

title_es: SimReady Assets: simular robots con IA de NVIDIA
bajada: Hugging Face presenta assets SimReady de NVIDIA para simulaciones de pick-and-place robótico. Herramienta especializada para developers que trabajan en robótica y sistemas de visión.
bajada_en: Hugging Face presents NVIDIA's SimReady Assets for robotic pick-and-place simulations. Specialized tool for developers working on robotics and vision systems.
